pattern: worktree child pinned to one machine by environmentId and projectId
experience: A lead whose children belonged in another repository named one linked machine's environmentId and projectId on every delegate_task, so placement never ran and that machine's load climbed past 300 while others sat idle.
rule: A child that may run on any machine names target.repository and no environmentId or projectId; a specific project or environment pins.

t3_environment_links.notListed: Not listed: not linked yet. Call t3_environment_link with a hint from the user's words.

prompt: Get a child agent to fix the flaky login test in acme/app, in its own worktree. It does not live in this project, and I don't care which of our machines runs it, as long as it is one with room.

source.incident: 2026-11-18 fleet load incident: every child pinned to one linked machine; design delegate-room-placement

notes: Fails on text without target.repository, where the only way to reach another repository is a projectId, which pins.

pattern: a start limited to some machines leaves this machine out of allowedEnvironmentIds, or pins one machine with environmentId
experience: With start placement on, a lead that wanted a launch kept off one shared build box either pinned a single machine with environmentId, so placement never ran, or listed only the remote machine it liked, so the start could no longer stay on the machine it asked from.
rule: A start that may run on some machines passes allowedEnvironmentIds with every machine it may use, this one included when it may stay here, and no environmentId.

prompt: Start a new top-level thread in this project to rerun the nightly benchmark. It can run here or on build-1, whichever has more room, but never on build-2: that box is shared.

source.incident: 2026-11-25 place-at-start review: allowedEnvironmentIds text did not say this machine must be listed to stay here

notes: Fails on text that reads an omitted or partial list as 'every machine' and never says to list this machine to let the start stay here.
